## <a:Timestamps:1523762211103969420> Timestamps
-# Turn any date or time into a timestamp everyone sees in their own time zone

### `d timestamp <date/time> [zone]`
`ts` · `time` · `convert`

**Date or time**
Type it the way you'd say it, or a range.
-# Such as `tomorrow 8pm` · `in 2 days` · `8pm to 10pm` · `dec 24 to dec 26`

**Time zone**
At the end, any IANA name, short name, city or country. `tz:` in front works too.
> -# **IANA names** `asia/tokyo` · `europe/london` · `america/chicago` *+ more*
> -# **Short names** `est` · `pst` · `cst` · `gmt` · `cet` · `ist` · `jst` *+ more*
> -# **Cities** `nyc` · `london` · `tokyo` · `sydney` · `dubai` *+ more*
> -# **Countries** `uk` · `india` *+ more*
> -# **Offsets** `utc+5` · `gmt-4` · `utc+5:30` *+ more*
-# Blank uses your `d settings` time zone default

**Reply to a message**
-# Reply with `d ts` and every time in that message is converted

**Right-click or tap and hold a message**
-# Apps → **Convert Times**: every date and time in it, in your own time zone

-# **Examples**
-# `d ts tomorrow 8pm`  Tomorrow, 8 PM
-# `d time fri 6pm tokyo`  Friday, 6 PM in Tokyo
-# `d ts 8pm to 10pm tz:pst`  A range, Pacific
-# `d ts`  As a reply: that message's times
-# Usage: `d cmd <required> [optional]`

## <a:ServerSettings:1536468904996774008> Server Settings
-# Config custom settings for Dioreo in your server.
-# These control where Dioreo answers **publicly or privately for /slash commands**, and where **typed (prefix) commands are allowed or disabled**.

### `/admin`
<a:Info:1564319073540513913> **Important:** an admin needs the **Manage Server** permission to use this command!
-# /admin only works as a slash command, so use it in a channel where you have **Use Application Commands** enabled.

`[visibility]`
-# Show only to you, or everyone in the chat

**Config Text Commands**
Set typed commands like `d today` **on or off**
> -# **On**  *the command works (Dioreo replies publicly)*
> -# **Off**  *the command is disabled (Dioreo stays silent)*
> -# **Prefix**  *your own in place of `d`; `dior` and `@Dioreo` always work. **Reset to d** puts it back*
> -# **Admins**  *can use typed commands anywhere, whatever is off*

**Config Slash Commands**
Set slash commands like `/today` **public or private**
> -# **Public**  *Dioreo's replies are visible to everyone in the channel*
> -# **Private**  *only the person who ran the command sees the reply*

**Pages in the panel**
> -# **Overview**  *Your default, and every rule at a glance*
> -# **Channels**  *Channel-specific settings*
> -# **Roles**  *Role-specific settings, everywhere or in some channels*
> -# **Commands**  *Each command's own settings*
> -# **Help**  *How the rules work, in full*

**Extra Tools**
> -# **Check a Member**  *What a member gets, and why*
> -# **Export Log**  *An audit safeguard: every /admin change in the last 60 days. It can't be deleted*
> -# **Reset Slash Rules · Reset Text Rules**  *Back to the defaults, for that view only*

**Which rule wins**
-# A command with its own settings uses only those; every other command uses the server's. Then the first that applies:
> -# **`1`** Their role, in this channel
> -# **`2`** Their role, everywhere
> -# **`3`** This channel *(threads follow it)*
> -# **`4`** Your default
-# Two roles that disagree: Public (or On) wins, as in Discord's own permissions

**<a:Info:1564319073540513913> Good to know...**
> -# **Private** always wins over someone's own choice
> -# **Public** allows it; anyone who chose private in their own /settings still gets private
> -# **Typed commands** are never private: turn them off instead
> -# **Admins** skip a command's own slash settings; the default, channel and role rules still apply to them
> -# **Rules apply only while Dioreo is in your server.** Without it, members' own installs follow each member's own /settings. Turning off **Use External Apps** in a channel makes every app answer privately there

-# **Common setups**
-# 🔸 **Private, except one channel**: Overview → **Private**, then Channels → *Always public in these channels…* → `#bot-spam`
-# 🔸 **Mods always public**: Roles → *Always public for these roles…* → `@Moderator`
-# 🔸 **One command private**: Commands → *Open a command's settings…* → `/colors` → **Private**
-# 🔸 **Typed commands off in one channel**: Config Text Commands → Channels → *Off in these channels…* → `#general`
-# 🔸 **Your own prefix**: Config Text Commands → **Edit Prefix** → `!`
-# Usage: `/cmd <required> [optional]` · no text command

## <a:ServerSettings:1536468904996774008> Server Settings
-# Config custom settings for Dioreo in your server.
-# These control where Dioreo answers **publicly or privately for /slash commands**, and where **typed (prefix) commands are allowed or disabled**.

### `/admin`
<a:Info:1564319073540513913> **Important:** an admin needs the **Manage Server** permission to use this command!
-# /admin only works as a slash command, so use it in a channel where you have **Use Application Commands** enabled.

`[visibility]`
-# Show only to you, or everyone in the chat

**Config Text Commands**
Set typed commands like `d today` **on or off**
> -# **On**  *the command works (Dioreo replies publicly)*
> -# **Off**  *the command is disabled (Dioreo stays silent)*
> -# **Prefix**  *your own in place of `d`; `dior` and `@Dioreo` always work. **Reset to d** puts it back*
> -# **Admins**  *can use typed commands anywhere, whatever is off*

**Config Slash Commands**
Set slash commands like `/today` **public or private**
> -# **Public**  *Dioreo's replies are visible to everyone in the channel*
> -# **Private**  *only the person who ran the command sees the reply*

**Pages in the panel**
> -# **Overview**  *Your default, and every rule at a glance*
> -# **Channels**  *Channel-specific settings*
> -# **Roles**  *Role-specific settings, everywhere or in some channels*
> -# **Commands**  *Each command's own settings*
> -# **Help**  *How the rules work, in full*

**Extra Tools**
> -# **Check a Member**  *What a member gets, and why*
> -# **Export Log**  *An audit safeguard: every /admin change in the last 60 days. It can't be deleted*
> -# **Reset Slash Rules · Reset Text Rules**  *Back to the defaults, for that view only*

**Which rule wins**
-# A command with its own settings uses only those; every other command uses the server's. Then the first that applies:
> -# **`1`** Their role, in this channel
> -# **`2`** Their role, everywhere
> -# **`3`** This channel *(threads follow it)*
> -# **`4`** Your default
-# Two roles that disagree: Public (or On) wins, as in Discord's own permissions

**<a:Info:1564319073540513913> Good to know...**
> -# **Private** always wins over someone's own choice
> -# **Public** allows it; anyone who chose private in their own /settings still gets private
> -# **Typed commands** are never private: turn them off instead
> -# **Admins** skip a command's own slash settings; the default, channel and role rules still apply to them
> -# **Rules apply only while Dioreo is in your server.** Without it, members' own installs follow each member's own /settings. Turning off **Use External Apps** in a channel makes every app answer privately there

-# **Common setups**
-# 🔸 **Private, except one channel**: Overview → **Private**, then Channels → *Always public in these channels…* → `#bot-spam`
-# 🔸 **Mods always public**: Roles → *Always public for these roles…* → `@Moderator`
-# 🔸 **One command private**: Commands → *Open a command's settings…* → `/colors` → **Private**
-# 🔸 **Typed commands off in one channel**: Config Text Commands → Channels → *Off in these channels…* → `#general`
-# 🔸 **Your own prefix**: Config Text Commands → **Edit Prefix** → `!`
-# Usage: `/cmd <required> [optional]` · no text command

## <a:Timestamps:1523762211103969420> Timestamps
-# Turn any date or time into a timestamp everyone sees in their own time zone

### `d timestamp <date/time> [zone]`

**Date or time**
Type it the way you'd say it, or a range.
-# Such as `tomorrow 8pm` · `in 2 days` · `8pm to 10pm` · `dec 24 to dec 26`

**Time zone**
At the end, any IANA name, short name, city or country. `tz:` in front works too.
> -# **IANA names** `asia/tokyo` · `europe/london` · `america/chicago` *+ more*
> -# **Short names** `est` · `pst` · `cst` · `gmt` · `cet` · `ist` · `jst` *+ more*
> -# **Cities** `nyc` · `london` · `tokyo` · `sydney` · `dubai` *+ more*
> -# **Countries** `uk` · `india` *+ more*
> -# **Offsets** `utc+5` · `gmt-4` · `utc+5:30` *+ more*
-# Blank uses your `d settings` time zone default

**Reply to a message**
-# Reply with `d ts` and every time in that message is converted

**Right-click or tap and hold a message**
-# Apps → **Convert Times**: every date and time in it, in your own time zone

-# **Examples**
-# `d ts tomorrow 8pm`  Tomorrow, 8 PM
-# `d time fri 6pm tokyo`  Friday, 6 PM in Tokyo
-# `d ts 8pm to 10pm tz:pst`  A range, Pacific
-# `d ts`  As a reply: that message's times

-# `d prefix`  This server's prefix
-# `d pre !`  Set it to ! (admins)
